você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de caixa . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa, bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • atender clientes com gentileza e encantamento;
  • finalizar as vendas utilizando o sistema LINX, garantindo uma experiência positiva ao cliente;
  • prestar atendimento online nos canais digitais;
  • responsável por abrir e fechar o caixa, conferindo todas as transações e garantindo que os valores em dinheiro, cartões e outros pagamentos estejam corretos, seguindo os procedimentos financeiros da empresa;

  • gestão das solicitações de insumos;
  • gerenciamento de contas a pagar;
  • operação de processos de omnichannel;
  • participação em inventários;
  • garantia de pleno funcionamento de processos e equipamentos da loja.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • trabalhar bem em equipe, com espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;

  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • vale transporte;
  • para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida: wellz (plataforma de saúde mental e bem estar)
  • assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;
  • política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais
  • wellhub (Antigo Gympass)
  • day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • e a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo Azzas.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

Location: Johor Bahru, MY

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

To ensure the effective planning and scheduling of VSO assets in support of TechnipFMC’s projects. The Strategic Planner - VSO is responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date asset schedules, supporting tender activities, and aligning operational and project timelines to optimize asset utilization and project execution.

Job Description

  • Manage and update the corporate schedule for assigned vessels using Primavera P6.
  • Monitor changes and proactively update schedules based on the latest project and operational information.
  • Create, maintain, and simulate planning scenarios across all phases of work, including Long‑Term Planning (S&OP, Budget, Master Scheduling), Tendering, and Execution.
  • Ensure integration between asset and project schedules, maintaining alignment between VSO (Vessel Scheduling & Operations) and Project activities. Participate in meetings for discussions and decisions, upscale issues, and provide visibility to stakeholders through the management system.
  • Ensure compliance with internal planning standards and reporting requirements.
  • Regularly interface with regional operations teams to communicate vessel movements and project status (delays, accelerations, scope changes, etc.).
  • Maintain continuous communication with stakeholders from both Projects and VSO regarding asset activities.
  • Attend weekly regional conference calls, issue Minutes of Meeting (MoM), and follow up on action items.
  • Develop ad‑hoc scenario schedules to support business case preparation and strategic vessel utilization decisions.
  • Develop and report KPIs, including rework, weather impact, breakdowns, contingency time, and utilization data.
  • Plan scope by sequencing activities, tracking progress, identifying risks, working with stakeholders on mitigation plans, escalating issues, reporting, controlling delivery metrics, and participating in Obeya and other meetings.
  • Support the development of tools and processes to monitor asset activity and facilitate decision‑making for resource allocation. Participate in the Asset Allocation Process and manage changes to minimize execution risks.
  • Contribute to cross‑functional process improvement initiatives to enhance execution efficiency.
  • Strengthen the global VSO Planning community: build competencies, share best practices, foster collaboration, and promote knowledge exchange across teams.
  • Identify and/or contribute to global planning improvement initiatives aligned with the overall VSO and TechnipFMC strategy, with a focus on Lean methodology.
  • Promote the effective and diverse use of systems to simplify execution and increase operational visibility.

You are meant for this job if:

Qualifications (professional, technical, academic)

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering, Administration, Supply Chain or related areas or equivalent experience in a technical or science based subject.

Experience/Skills/Knowledge

  • 2-5 years working knowledge of offshore vessels or manufacturing is preferably.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze trends or deviations from standards and recommend creative and unique cross‑functional solutions.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the communication process and ensures effectiveness (written, verbal and listening) across functional boundaries.
  • Prepares and delivers somewhat simple proposals and reports to planning audience.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Open to give and receive constructive feedback.
  • Good workload management and organisation skills.
  • Confident in hosting meetings and presentation skills.

Technical/General Competencies

  • Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project
  • Microsoft Excel (Advanced user)
  • Data analysis
  • Developing and using KPIs

Skills

title: Stadium Guest Operations Manager
description:
Stadium Guest Operations Manager

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Guest Operations Stadium Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of seamless V/VIP guest services and operations within the stadiums for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, internal FIFA27 teams, and external stakeholders. The role acts as the primary point of reference for all stadium guest operations, ensuring efficient planning, staff readiness, and high-quality service delivery during match operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of V/VIP services and guest operations across assigned stadiums.
  • Establish, manage, and coordinate stadium-level Guest Operations teams, ensuring clear task allocation in line with the event scope.
  • Support the Guest Operations Senior Manager in the development and implementation of Concepts of Operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Communicate guest management policies, stadium operational plans, and updates to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure management of V/ VIP Guests (local & international) is according to agreed operational plans.
  • Ensure agreed service levels are consistently delivered in collaboration with internal departments, service providers, and partners.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Guest Experience Manager on the planning and delivery of V/VIP catering services and lounge experience within the stadium environment.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage key milestones, activity schedules, and workflows, ensuring clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to budget planning and support the monitoring and review of stadium guest operations expenditures.
  • Plan and deliver stadium-specific V/VIP operations training for Guest Operations Stadium staff, volunteers, hosts, and hostesses.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Tourism, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.
  • Proven experience in stadium or venue-based operations, including V/VIP services and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, coordination, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working with multiple service providers and cross-functional teams in complex operational settings.
  • Experience in budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial tracking is desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and deliver high-quality guest services through structured processes and teamwork.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
  • High level of attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and sound judgement under pressure.
  • Good understanding of organisational processes, governance, and operational policies.
  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and event days, as required by the tournament schedule.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Atualmente, realizamos mais de 400 mil consultas por mês, sendo 180 mil em saúde mental. Com o nosso modelo de negócios, conseguimos cobrir 24 milhões de vidas.

A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito.   • Excel em nível avançado;

  • Forte habilidade com números e cálculos, com pensamento analítico e senso crítico;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir análises em insights;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com autonomia para gerir múltiplas demandas;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipe, flexibilidade e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

Diferenciais

An Operations Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that a team’s day-to-day activities run smoothly and align with the organization’s strategic objectives. Descrição da oferta de emprego

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.
  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas térmelétricas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);

title: Executive Assistant BRA (Remote)
description:
An Executive Assistant (EA) provides high-level administrative support to executives, senior leaders, or company founders, ensuring their schedules, communications, and daily operations run smoothly . This role acts as a strategic partner, enabling executives to focus on decision-making and leadership responsibilities while the EA manages essential organizational and logistical tasks behind the scenes.

Typical responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars with multiple time zones, organizing and prioritizing meetings, preparing agendas, and ensuring executives are fully briefed ahead of engagements. Executive Assistants also arrange travel itineraries —including flights, accommodations, and transportation—while anticipating potential issues and providing contingency plans.

Beyond scheduling, EAs are often responsible for drafting and editing correspondence , preparing high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing documents , and managing internal and external communications on behalf of the executive. Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion is critical, as is maintaining a professional demeanor when liaising with board members, clients, and other stakeholders.

An effective EA also monitors project timelines , follows up on action items, and acts as a gatekeeper—managing requests for the executive’s time and attention while balancing competing priorities. They often identify opportunities to streamline processes, implement productivity tools , and enhance the efficiency of the executive office.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills , keen attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced and high-pressure environments, and excellent communication abilities. The most effective Executive Assistants combine administrative expertise with strategic thinking, becoming an indispensable partner in the achievement of organizational goals.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
As the Senior Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk management at Keeta.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider / driver / courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility / delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs). Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics. Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics. Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization. Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.
  • Proficient in SQL and Python / R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement) Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier / driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver / courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety / quality frameworks. Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary) Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred. Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.
  • Soft Skills Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities. Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders. Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

  • Strong analytical abilities, detail-oriented and high level of accuracy

  • Working knowledge of Google spreadsheets, Microsoft Word and Gmail

  • Adept researching and problem-solving capabilities

  • Someone who thrives in a collaborative, teamwork environment

  • Aptitude for prioritizing tasks with an attention to detail to ensure information accuracy

  • Ability to work in a flexible, fast-paced environment to meet multiple deadlines and adapt to new policies and procedures

  • An ability to work cross-functionally to ensure application processing consistency and efficiency

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills under ambiguous circumstances to ensure we provide the best outcome for our students while maintaining integrity with our partner relationships

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and verbal and written communication skills.

About ApplyBoard

ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access the best education. With more than 1,000,000 students from over 150 countries helped with their journey in less than a decade, we are just getting started.

ApplyBoard’s global team assists students and our 1,500+ partner institutions by empowering the international student sector with innovative technology and insights. As a five-time consecutive Deloitte Fast 50 and Fast 500 ranked company, ApplyBoard keeps international students at the heart of everything we do.

Thank you for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard Team and being part of our mission to Educate the World. While we are lucky to attract a high level of interest in each of our roles, only qualified applicants will be contacted and selected for an interview.

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high‑quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise daytoday accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue‑based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to postevent reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Planning and Integration Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with project management tools is an asset.
  • A good proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau for reporting.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools and systems for managing complex projects.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Overlay Cluster Manager
description:
Overlay Cluster Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

Role to transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
  • Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; additional language(s) is an asset.
  • Availability to travel as needed
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Senior Manager, Special Events

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world‑class event experiences that elevate the tournament’s global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ special events. The role ensures seamless, high‑quality delivery aligned with FIFA’s brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

  • Official Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre‑match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

2. Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
  • Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™.

3. Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

6. Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

YOUR PROFILE

Education
  • A Master’s degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large‑scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.
Experience
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high‑profile, broadcast‑level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi‑million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega‑events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies Strategic & Operational Excellence
  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.
Leadership & Team Management
  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong decision‑making skills under pressure.
Financial & Commercial Acumen
  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost‑control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.
Personal Attributes
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA’s values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.
Requiriments
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Coordenador(A) Operacional - Pátio De Madeira
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Coordenar as operações de Pátio de Madeiras, administrando e otimizando os recursos, orçamentos, equipamentos e atividades, assegurando os níveis de estoques, visando o cumprimento das metas de abastecimento da fábrica, garantindo a segurança das pessoas, custos adequados e a eficiência dos serviços prestados.

Principais Atividades :

  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas diárias, semanais e mensais de recebimento de madeira, conforme planejamento, padrões de qualidade e com custos adequados, garantindo a segurança do time envolvido na execução das atividades;
  • Dimensionar e distribuir os recursos necessários para a execução das atividades de Pátio de Madeira e abastecimento das linhas de picagem, analisando e realizando ajustes no processo para manter a qualidade da madeira posto fábrica, níveis e acuracidade de estoques, contribuindo para o atingimento das metas de abastecimento da fábrica;
  • Realizar a apuração final de todo o volume de madeira posto fábrica, garantindo a utilização dos sistemas de pesagem e cubicagem de madeira, para a contabilização final junto à área de controladoria de toda a produção florestal;
  • Garantir o abastecimento das linhas de picagem de acordo com a programação dos requisitos do processo e indicadores chave (TPC, densidade, umidade, FIFO, material clonal entre outros);
  • Garantir o abastecimento constante das linhas de picagem através da chegada dos caminhões de campo ou baldeio, de modo a manter o fluxo de picagem de maneira constante;
  • Participar das reuniões entre florestal e industrial, conforme calendário vigente, de modo ser um dos representantes da florestal nas interfaces de abastecimento de fábrica;
  • Administrar o posto de combustível, dimensionando os recursos necessários para o funcionamento, criando procedimentos de funcionamento e de segurança dos colaboradores, controlando os custos mensais, analisando indicadores e intervindo nos processos, visando sempre o estoque adequado e o abastecimento das máquinas em campo;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar a Torre de Controle, através de sistemas de gestão de pátio, rastreamento de veículos e dados em tempo real para otimizar o fluxo de caminhões, garantindo pontualidade e reduzindo o tempo de espera;
  • Coordenar o processo de monitoramento da Logística Florestal, informando ao PCP a disponibilidade de caminhões, intervindo nas rotas e distribuição dos caminhões nas frentes de trabalho, visando o cumprimento das metas de abastecimento da Fábrica e a manutenção do nível de segurança dos estoques do Pátio de Madeiras;
  • Coordenar as informações e a comunicação entre motoristas, transportadores, operadores de pátio, segurança e áreas internas (produção, suprimentos), monitorando e resolvendo proativamente desvios operacionais e gargalos logísticos;
  • Assegurar a realização de todas as atividades de sua área de atuação, através da gestão do time direto e gestão de contratos (se houver), realizando as interfaces com as áreas de planejamento, Carregamento e Transporte, Industrial, manutenção etc., bem como, atuando e intervindo nos processos, visando o cumprimento das metas, promovendo a segurança do time envolvido e custos adequados;
  • Gerir a disponibilidade dos equipamentos (caminhões e máquinas), o consumo de combustíveis e demais custos de operação, acompanhando os indicadores e intervindo no processo em caso de desvios / oportunidades, visando a otimização dos equipamentos, cumprimento das metas com custos adequados;
  • Participar dos estudos de terceirização e / ou primarização, fornecendo informações, dados de indicadores, avaliando os riscos e ameaças dessas modalidades, os custos envolvidos, a sustentação em longo prazo e a nova forma de gerir essas demandas, garantindo sempre a qualidade, quantidade e a segurança de todos os envolvidos nos processos;

  • Garantir a qualidade e pontualidade das informações repassadas para os indicadores diários, semanais e mensais referente aos estoques de madeira;
  • Administrar as demandas da sua área de atuação, através dos indicadores de disponibilidade operacional e mecânica dos equipamentos, cronogramas e demais indicadores necessários para entendimento e avaliação do desempenho e entregas da área, agindo e intervindo no processo e planejamento, buscando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias nos processos de sua responsabilidade, gerando demanda para a área de projetos, visando a melhoria contínua dos processos;

Incentivar e apoiar projetos de desenvolvimento operacional e inovação, provendo os recursos necessários, visando a maior disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos, aumento da produtividade e otimização dos custos de produção.

  • Administrar os custos da sua área de atuação, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), a gestão e acompanhamento mensal dos custos realizados, através das aprovações dos gastos, reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos;
  • Gerir o time da sua área de atuação, alinhando segurança, qualidade, produtividade e custos, promovendo o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, oferecendo orientação e suporte;

description:

Descrição da vaga

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos :

Líder de Consultoria e Processos

Resumo do Propósito da Função :

Como um contribuinte fundamental para a excelência operacional, o Consultor de Processos & Melhoria Contínua (CI) conduz iniciativas impactantes de melhoria de processos em toda a organização. Atuando como um assessor de confiança, este cargo é responsável por padronizar, implementar e otimizar processos críticos para aumentar a eficiência e o desempenho. Utilizando sua expertise em melhoria contínua, o consultor garante que as soluções estejam alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais e entreguem resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis, promovendo uma cultura de inovação e progresso contínuo.

O Consultor Interno de Processos & CI trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Head de Consultoria de Processos, assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia global e contribuindo para os objetivos mais amplos estabelecidos no plano de 5 anos (5YP) e em outras iniciativas estratégicas de negócios.

Responsabilidades :

  • Desenho Excelência Operacional e Otimização de Processos : apoiar e conduzir iniciativas de melhoria de processos destinadas a elevar a excelência operacional, simplificando processos, estimulando a inovação, melhorando a eficiência e desenvolvendo novas formas de trabalho. Realizar análises detalhadas para identificar ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos existentes, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Assegurar que as mudanças sejam sustentáveis, implementadas de forma eficaz e que seu impacto no desempenho seja mensurável.
  • Desenho e Otimização de Processos End-to-End (E2E) : atuar como consultor no design e implementação de processos operacionais eficientes, garantindo a criação de soluções robustas e escaláveis que ampliem o desempenho operacional em toda a organização. Ter um papel fundamental na tomada de decisões operacionais, garantindo que os processos sejam concebidos para serem replicáveis e adaptáveis em diferentes regiões e contextos. Oferecer suporte e assistência contínua no desenvolvimento de soluções operacionais personalizadas, alinhadas ao pipeline de desenvolvimento de Operações & TI, agilizando processos, sistemas e ferramentas para criar um ambiente de trabalho mais eficiente e eficaz.
  • Colaboração Multifuncional : atuar como elo entre as operações locais para facilitar o trabalho colaborativo entre equipes, assegurando alinhamento e compartilhamento de conhecimento para promover uma cultura de processos padronizados, disseminação de boas práticas e melhoria contínua.
  • Medição de Desempenho : desenvolver indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar processos, desempenho de serviços e o impacto das iniciativas de melhoria, fornecendo insights aos stakeholders e apoiando ferramentas e sistemas que garantam dados provenientes de fontes válidas e integradas.
  • Programa de Melhoria Contínua : colaborar como parte da equipe global de Melhoria Contínua para executar, monitorar e aprimorar o programa. Engajar-se ativamente e apoiar a rede de colaboradores treinados para impulsionar projetos contínuos de melhoria de processos, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais e entregando ganhos de desempenho mensuráveis.
  • Colaboração Geográfica : apoiar equipes operacionais desde a Malásia até a Costa Rica, com base em prioridades definidas e em coordenação com o gestor direto, garantindo uma colaboração fluida e eficiente entre equipes / regiões.
  • Executar tarefas atribuídas pelo Head de Consultoria de Processos com base nas prioridades do ELT e iniciativas estratégicas.

Competências :

  • Adaptar o estilo de comunicação para transmitir mensagens de forma eficaz a diferentes públicos dentro das equipes e a stakeholders, garantindo clareza e promovendo compreensão nas interações do dia a dia.
  • Facilitar reuniões e discussões de equipe, assegurando que ações e prazos claros sejam definidos, mantendo a equipe alinhada e focada na entrega dos objetivos do projeto.
  • Construção de relações de trabalho positivas e promover a colaboração dentro das equipes de Operações (países e domínios) e com outros stakeholders, garantindo trabalho em equipe eficaz e partilha de ideias para apoiar o sucesso dos projetos.
  • Identificar proativamente áreas de melhoria e assumir a responsabilidade de impulsionar iniciativas de melhoria contínua dentro das diferentes equipas, garantindo progresso rumo aos objetivos operacionais.
  • Influenciar de forma eficaz colegas e membros da equipe para obter apoio às iniciativas de melhoria de processos, utilizando persuasão e colaboração para garantir alinhamento e implementação bem-sucedida das mudanças.

CONHECIMENTOS & EXPERIÊNCIA :

Essencial :

  • Proficiência na metodologia Lean Six Sigma (certificação Green Belt ou superior).
  • Experiência comprovada em mapeamento de processos e metodologias de melhoria de processos.
  • Experiência na implementação de ferramentas e técnicas de melhoria contínua, como Kaizen e DMAIC (Definir, Medir, Analisar, Melhorar, Controlar).
  • Capacidade de liderar projetos de melhoria de processos de ponta a ponta de forma eficaz.
  • Proficiência no uso e desenvolvimento em ferramentas online da Microsoft, como SharePoint, Power Automate e Power BI.
  • Proficiência em inglês falado e escrito.

Desejável :

New Opportunity – Network Support Technician

We’re working with a leading global tech organization that is looking for an experienced Network Support Technician to join their team in Guarulhos, Brazil.

Overview

The Network Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, monitoring, and troubleshooting an organization’s network infrastructure. This role supports LAN, WAN, and wireless networks to ensure reliable connectivity, security, and optimal performance for users and business systems.

  • Install, configure, and maintain network hardware including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity issues related to TCP / IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, and switching.
  • Monitor network performance and respond to outages or degradation in service.
  • Support LAN, WAN, VPN, and WLAN environments.
  • Perform IP addressing, subnetting, and VLAN configurations.
  • Assist with network upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure refresh projects.
  • Maintain network cabling, patch panels, and labeling standards.
  • Implement and support basic network security measures such as access controls and VPN connectivity.
  • Document network diagrams, configurations, procedures, and incident resolutions.
  • Work with system administrators, security teams, and vendors to resolve escalated issues.

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are:

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across an array of brands

  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required

  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + FCPX

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)

  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)

  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment

  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices

  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication skills

  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do:

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats

  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging

  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats

  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels

  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment

  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Ingesting and logging footage

  • Working in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines

  • Editing lower-level projects

  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs

  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits

  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)

  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment

  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms

  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior para atuar em um ecossistema de aplicativos digitais iOS e Android, com múltiplos produtos, marcas e integrações, garantindo qualidade técnica, performance e experiência consistente para o usuário final.

Você precisa ser uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia, com forte perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo, capaz de atuar em arquitetura, sustentação e evolução de apps em produção em um ambiente ágil.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicativos móveis em Flutter (Dart) para Android e iOS, desde a concepção até a publicação e manutenção, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
  • Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
  • Integrar os apps com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo autenticação, tratamento robusto de erros e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
  • Atuar na sustentação dos aplicativos: correção de bugs, investigação com logs e Crashlytics, análise de performance e prevenção de regressões.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de widgets), garantindo cobertura mínima em fluxos críticos de negócio e UI.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), contribuindo para decisões técnicas e de produto.
  • Colaborar com times de back-end, produto e design na definição de contratos de API, integrações, Design System e experiências consistentes entre plataformas.
  • Apoiar e evoluir a observabilidade dos apps (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config) e a experimentação via testes A/B.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e, quando necessário, participação em etapas técnicas de seleção (entrevistas e avaliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência sólida com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo publicação e manutenção de apps em Android e iOS.
  • Forte domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura em camadas, Clean separação de responsabilidades e gerenciamento de estado com GetX (lifecycle, .obs, Obx, GetBuilder).
  • Vivência com testes unitários e testes de widgets em Flutter, aplicados a lógica de negócio e componentes de UI.
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.
  • Conhecimento de Git (Bitbucket ou equivalentes), fluxos de pull request e práticas de code review.
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com múltiplas marcas / white-label apps, mantendo configurações distintas em um ecossistema compartilhado de packages.
  • Vivência com packages interconectados, modularização e gestão de dependências locais (path-based dependencies) e overrides.
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

Informações adicionais

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Vale Transporte;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Gympass;

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;

Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

Código de Vendedor, com direito a comissão sobre vendas nos sites;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;

Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;

Avaliação de desempenho;

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

A Longitude é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia , especializada em projetos nos setores de energia, marítimo, naval, offshore e renováveis . Parte do ABL Group , atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, sempre com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade .

Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

  • Safety first – segurança sempre em primeiro lugar
  • Technical excellence – qualidade e precisão técnica
  • Collaboration – trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança
  • Innovation – melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes
  • Integrity & transparency – ética, clareza e responsabilidade

Sobre a vaga

Você atuará como Engineering Job Leader da disciplina Elétrica , sendo o responsável técnico direto pelo desenvolvimento, coordenação e qualidade das entregas de engenharia elétrica em projetos offshore .

Além da atuação nos projetos locais, o profissional interagirá ativamente com projetos da Longitude ao redor do mundo , colaborando com equipes globais no compartilhamento de experiências, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas , bem como prestando suporte técnico a projetos internacionais , fortalecendo a excelência técnica e a padronização global da disciplina elétrica.

Principais Responsabilidades

⚡ Liderar tecnicamente a disciplina elétrica , definindo escopo, prioridades, estratégias de execução e padrões técnicos dos projetos.

? Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos e estudos elétricos , incluindo Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) , listas de carga, estudos de curto-circuito, arco elétrico, coordenação e harmônicos .

✅ Revisar, validar e aprovar tecnicamente os entregáveis elétricos produzidos por equipes internas ou empresas subcontratadas, atuando como autoridade técnica da disciplina .

? Garantir a conformidade com normas técnicas , regulamentos aplicáveis e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras (ABS, DNV, BV, entre outras).

? Gerenciar interfaces técnicas com outras disciplinas (Processo, Instrumentação, Naval, Estrutural, Automação), assegurando integração e consistência do projeto.

? Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente , participando de reuniões técnicas, análises críticas e tomada de decisões.

? Colaborar com equipes globais da Longitude , apoiando projetos internacionais e promovendo padronização, melhoria contínua e compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico .

Requisitos

? Formação Acadêmica
Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.

⚡ Experiência Profissional
Experiência sólida em engenharia elétrica aplicada a projetos offshore , preferencialmente em FPSOs e plataformas de produção e experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica ou líder técnico da disciplina elétrica .

? Conhecimentos Técnicos
Conhecimento aprofundado de normas técnicas internacionais (IEC, IEEE, API, NORSOK) e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras.

? Ferramentas e Sistemas
Experiência com softwares de estudos elétricos (ex.: ETAP, SKM, PowerFactory ou similares).

? Idiomas
Inglês fluente (obrigatório), com capacidade de comunicação técnica em ambiente internacional.

✈️ Disponibilidade
Disponibilidade para viagens e embarques eventuais , reuniões presenciais e suporte técnico a projetos onshore e offshore.

Diferenciais

⭐ Experiência em projetos internacionais ou atuação em ambientes multiculturais.
⭐ Vivência com FPSOs e unidades de produção offshore.
⭐ Conhecimento avançado emsegurança elétrica , estudos de arco elétrico e classificação de áreas.

O que oferecemos para você

? Plano de saúde e odontológico extensíveis a dependentes sem desconto .
? Modelo híbrido de trabalho e horário flexível .

?️ Seguro de vida .
? Interface constante com times internacionais , promovendo trocas globais de conhecimento.
? Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) , com possibilidade de custeio de cursos e certificações pela empresa .
? Acesso gratuito à ABL Academy , com amplo portfólio de cursos técnicos.
?️ Aulas gratuitas de inglês e espanhol , com professora no escritório.
?️ Wellhub (Gympass) para saúde física e bem-estar.
? Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos .
? Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e internacional, com foco em excelência e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.

  • Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.
  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
  • Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.

Intervenção

  • Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.
  • Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
  • Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
  • Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.

  • Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA.
  • Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
  • Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL
