CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Nesse contexto, a AVSI Brasil será responsável pela operacionalização de um projeto em parceria com a Águas do Rio, concessionária de distribuição de água potável que atua no município do Rio de Janeiro e na Baixada Fluminense. O projeto visa promover atividades de mobilização social, organização comunitária e ações educativas, com o objetivo de engajar e integrar as comunidades atendidas.

As atividades planejadas incluem ações de conscientização sobre as obras e iniciativas sociais do Rio, realizadas por meio de abordagens lúdicas, participativas e imersivas, voltadas para crianças, jovens e adultos. O objetivo é fortalecer o diálogo com as comunidades, promover a transparência, incentivar a participação social e consolidar uma relação de confiança entre a concessionária e a população local, contribuindo para a eficácia das ações e para o bem‑estar das comunidades envolvidas.

O Promotor(a) Social será responsável por planejar, executar e mediar ações educativas e socioculturais na área do Projeto Água do Rio, trabalhando diretamente com as comunidades atendidas, com foco em experiências lúdicas, participativas e imersivas.

Desenvolver dinâmicas educativas que estimulem a reflexão, o diálogo e a participação ativa do público, respeitando as especificidades de cada faixa etária;

Atuar como mediador entre o conteúdo do projeto e a comunidade, facilitando a compreensão das mensagens-chave por meio de jogos, experiências, rodas de conversas e atividades práticas;

title: Marketing Manager BRA (Remote)
description:
Marketing Manager

A Marketing Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing strategies that promote a company’s products or services, strengthen brand awareness, and drive sustainable growth. This role requires strategic oversight of marketing initiatives across both digital and traditional channels, ensuring alignment with the company’s objectives and target audience needs.

Key responsibilities include managing integrated marketing campaigns , from concept to execution, leveraging channels such as social media, email marketing, paid advertising, search engine optimization (SEO), content marketing, events, and print media. A Marketing Manager must analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscapes to identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation.

The role also involves overseeing the creation of compelling content and brand messaging , ensuring consistency in tone, style, and visual identity across all platforms. Collaboration is crucial—Marketing Managers often work closely with sales, product development, and creative teams to ensure that marketing efforts support lead generation, customer engagement, and revenue goals.

Performance tracking is another critical aspect. Marketing Managers monitor key metrics such as conversion rates, ROI, customer acquisition cost, and engagement rates , using data insights to refine strategies and improve effectiveness. They also manage budgets, allocate resources efficiently, and negotiate with vendors or media partners to maximize returns on investment.

To succeed in this role, a Marketing Manager must possess strong leadership and team management skills , the ability to think both creatively and analytically, and a deep understanding of modern marketing tools and technologies. Adaptability, problem-solving, and excellent communication are essential to navigate fast-changing market dynamics and deliver impactful results.

A Graphic Designer is responsible for creating compelling visual content that communicates a brand’s message effectively, captures attention, and engages its target audience. Scope of Work

Graphic Designers work on a variety of projects, including digital and print media —such as social media graphics, website layouts, online advertisements, email templates, presentations, infographics, packaging, brochures, and event materials. They are skilled at translating complex ideas into clear, aesthetically pleasing designs that align with the company’s brand identity, tone, and visual guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include collaborating with marketing teams, copywriters, and other stakeholders to conceptualize and execute design projects, selecting appropriate color schemes, typography, imagery, and layouts that resonate with the intended audience. They must also adapt designs for different formats and devices , ensuring visual consistency and usability across various channels.

Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in industry-standard design software—such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, or Canva —is essential. title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company’s products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.

This role involves researching and segmenting target markets , identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement —to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect’s industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company’s offerings.

Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings , and document all interactions in the company’s CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.

An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious , able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.

Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills , both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Administration

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, coordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience with project management tools is an asset.
  • A good proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau for reporting.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools and systems for managing complex projects.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Recruiter BRA (Remote)
description:
A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization’s staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals.

Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches.

The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer’s brand and long-term talent pipeline.

In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent.

To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company’s workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project ( and drive specialized data scraping workflows within our hybrid AI + human system.

In this role, as a AI Pilot – that's how we refer to this role at Mindrift – you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide critical thinking, domain expertise, and quality control to deliver accurate and actionable results.

This part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands‑on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Vibe Code specialist, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end‑to‑end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage internal tools (Apify, OpenRouter) alongside custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript‑rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross‑source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine‑tuning AI outputs, you'll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real‑world applications.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in data analysis, AI automation, data engineering, or software development is desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Python web scraping: Build reliable scraping scripts using BeautifulSoup, Selenium (or equivalents) for multi‑level sites, dynamic JS content (infinite scroll, AJAX), and API endpoints via provided proxy.
  • Data extraction expertise: Navigate complex hierarchical structures (regions → companies → details), handling archived pages and varied HTML formats.
  • Data processing: Clean, normalize, and validate scraped data; deliver high‑quality datasets in well‑structured formats (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets) with clear, consistent presentation.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem‑solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self‑directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper‑intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands‑on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly – a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance‑based bonus programs that reward high‑quality work and consistent delivery.

description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization. Key Responsibilities Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process. Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures. Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems. Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Execute structured outbound prospecting (calls, emails, LinkedIn, events) to secure first meetings with decision‑makers and influencers in engineering, operations, and supply chain. Open and quality new relationships (“new logos”) for M&O in the subsea market, convert leads into commercial opportunities and manage the full sales process from prospecting to contract closure, handing over matured accounts for farming when appropriate. Expand M&O’s reach among key players in the subsea market, ensuring ongoing engagement and account development. Product & Solution Representation Develop a strong technical understanding of subsea products and services in the M&O portfolio, including equipment, systems, intervention technologies and software used in subsea operations and integrity management. Lead initial discovery and capability meetings, presenting supplier solutions and tailoring the value proposition to Brazilian subsea project needs. Coordinate deeper technical discussions with supplier specialists while maintaining commercial ownership of the opportunity. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier innovations, certifications, and subsea industry standards. Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Um profissional que consiga ser um gestor de projetos eficaz, garantindo que a obra:

  • Seja segura e legal.
  • Seja concluída dentro do orçamento e do prazo.
  • Minimize o transtorno causado pela obra.

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

  • Garantir a Segurança e a Conformidade Legal
    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.
    Zelar pela conservação e segurança da edificação (Art. 1.348, V, do Código Civil), responsabilizando‑se por qualquer dano causado por negligência na fiscalização.
  • Autorizações e Documentação
    Analisar e aprovar o Plano de Reforma detalhado antes de qualquer obra ser iniciada.

    Manter a documentação da obra arquivada.
Requisitos
  • I. Requisitos Técnicos e Legais
    • Conhecimento da NBR 16.280: É obrigatório que o síndico conheça a fundo a norma que trata da Gestão de Reformas em Edificações.
    • Noções Básicas de Construção Civil: capacidade de ler e interpretar plantas simples, entender orçamentos, cronogramas e etapas.
    • Domínio do Código Civil (Obras): conhecer os quóruns de aprovação de obras (Artigos 1.341 a 1.343).
    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.
    • Gestão de Contratos: conhecer aspectos essenciais de contratos de empreitada/serviço.
  • II. Requisitos de Gestão e Administrativos
    • Organização e Método: gerar e controlar documentação, orçamentos e cronogramas.
    • Rigor Financeiro: elaborar previsões orçamentárias detalhadas e controlar desembolsos.
    • Planejamento Estratégico: priorizar obras de manutenção preventiva e planejar projetos de longo prazo.
    • Transparência: garantir clareza na seleção de fornecedores e prestação de contas.
  • III. Requisitos Comportamentais (Perfil)
    • Liderança e Proatividade: contratar consultorias, realizar cotações e manter preventivas.
    • Capacidade de Comunicação: informar moradores sobre impacto e dialogar com empreiteira.
    • Negociação e Imparcialidade: negociar contratos e prazos, mediar conflitos entre vizinhos.
    • Resolução de Problemas (Crise): lidar com atrasos, problemas estruturais e acidentes.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu. Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Landscape helps manage policy, compliance, patch management, and access control across large estates.

We have a system that serves thousands of deployments, and we want to give it a fresh vision. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills. You will work closely with product managers and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. You will grow a team of engineers, collaborate with other engineering and business teams, and provide periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage, helping them grow as engineers.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open‑source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4–6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Valued Skills and Experience
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high‑quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration
What We Offer
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Realizar a aferição da pressão de rede de distribuição de água e medidores;
  • Realizar demais atividades relacionadas a serviços de instalação/reparo e operação de água.

  • Interesse de atuar na área de Saneamento, levando diariamente dignidade nas porta das pessoas;

  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

$45,000-$55,000

Coordenador de Planejamento Logístico – Beep Saúde

Buscamos um Coordenador de Planejamento Logístico para liderar a orquestração da nossa operação, garantindo o equilíbrio perfeito entre capacidade, disponibilidade e demanda. Você será responsável por definir as áreas de atendimento, orquestrar a disponibilidade de slots e otimizar a produtividade da equipe, impulsionando a eficiência e a rentabilidade da Beep Saúde.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Definir e otimizar as áreas de atendimento: analisar dados geográficos, demográficos e de demanda para definir os limites das áreas de atendimento; monitorar a performance das áreas, identificando oportunidades de expansão ou reestruturação; garantir a viabilidade econômica das áreas, otimizando custos e maximizando a receita.
  • Orquestrar a disponibilidade de slots: planejar e controlar a oferta de slots, garantindo o equilíbrio entre capacidade e demanda; utilizar modelos preditivos para antecipar variações na demanda e ajustar a disponibilidade de slots; monitorar a taxa de ocupação e identificar oportunidades para otimizar a alocação de slots.
  • Otimizar a produtividade da equipe: analisar dados de produtividade da equipe e identificar oportunidades de melhoria; utilizar ferramentas de IA para otimizar a capacidade e reduzir o tempo de deslocamento; implementar estratégias para aumentar a eficiência operacional e reduzir custos.
  • Liderar a gestão de indicadores: definir e acompanhar os principais KPIs da área de Alocação, como receita por área, custo por área, taxa de ocupação e produtividade; analisar os dados e gerar insights para a tomada de decisões estratégicas; apresentar relatórios e recomendações para a alta gestão.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas: trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Vendas, Operações, RH e Tecnologia; participar de reuniões de S&OP e S&OE; atuar como ponto focal para questões relacionadas à alocação, fornecendo suporte e orientação para as demais áreas.

  • Experiência comprovada em supply planner ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente em empresas de rápido crescimento.

  • Habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e gerar insights relevantes.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de tomar decisões com base em dados.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar diferentes stakeholders.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Diferenciais: conhecimento em Power BI, SQL, experiência em IA.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities Project Ownership & Delivery
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.
Customer Storytelling & Consulting
  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.
Environment Implementation
  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)
AI-Driven Efficiency
  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing
  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.
Why Join TestBox
  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.
Benefits
  • Generous equity package for meaningful ownership
  • Prioritization of your professional growth, with dedicated career development support
  • Flexible, unlimited PTO with a minimum expectation for recharge
  • Mental Health benefits
  • Fitness allowances
  • Learning allowances
  • Remote and office setup allowances to ensure productive and comfortable working environments

Job description

Coordenador de Planejamento Logístico - Beep Saúde

Buscamos um Coordenador de Planejamento Logístico para liderar a orquestração da nossa operação, garantindo o equilíbrio perfeito entre capacidade, disponibilidade e demanda. Você será responsável por definir as áreas de atendimento, orquestrar a disponibilidade de slots e otimizar a produtividade da equipe, impulsionando a eficiência e a rentabilidade da Beep Saúde.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades:

Definir e otimizar as áreas de atendimento:

Analisar dados geográficos, demográficos e de demanda para definir os limites das áreas de atendimento.

Monitorar a performance das áreas, identificando oportunidades de expansão ou reestruturação.

Garantir a viabilidade econômica das áreas, otimizando custos e maximizando a receita.

Orquestrar a disponibilidade de slots:

Planejar e controlar a oferta de slots, garantindo o equilíbrio entre capacidade e demanda.

Utilizar modelos preditivos para antecipar variações na demanda e ajustar a disponibilidade de slots.

Monitorar a taxa de ocupação e identificar oportunidades para otimizar a alocação de slots.

Otimizar a produtividade da equipe:

Analisar dados de produtividade das técnicas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

Utilizar ferramentas de IA para otimizar a capacidade e reduzir o tempo de deslocamento.

Implementar estratégias para aumentar a eficiência operacional e reduzir custos.

Liderar a gestão de indicadores:

Definir e acompanhar os principais KPIs da área de Alocação, como receita por área, custo por área, taxa de ocupação e produtividade.

Analisar os dados e gerar insights para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Apresentar relatórios e recomendações para a alta gestão.

Colaborar com outras áreas:

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Vendas, Operações, RH e Tecnologia para garantir o alinhamento estratégico e a eficiência operacional.

Participar de reuniões de S&OP e S&OE para integrar o planejamento de demanda e capacidade.

Atuar como ponto focal para questões relacionadas à alocação, fornecendo suporte e orientação para as demais áreas.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

Experiência comprovada em supply planner ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente em empresas de rápido crescimento.

Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados, análise preditiva.

Habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e gerar insights relevantes.

Visão estratégica e capacidade de tomar decisões com base em dados.

Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar diferentes stakeholders.

Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado para resultados.

Diferenciais:

Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de consulta de dados (SQL).

Experiência em uso de ferramentas de IA.

Additional information

Benefícios para os Beepers:

  • Para sua saúde e de seus dependentes – Plano de Saúde e Odontológico | Sulamérica;
  • Benefício Farmácia: até 40% de desconto em medicamentos;

  • Para seu desenvolvimento: descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras;
  • Vale transporte;

Diarista de segunda a sexta, no horário de 09h às 18h

1.Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:

1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.3 – Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s , a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.

1.7 – Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.

1.8 – Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.

1.9 – Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.

2.1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica..
2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
2.5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
2.6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.

2.7.Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
2.12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
2.13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.

3 – Promover a parceria Escola/Família na condução do processo educacional :

3.2 – Inova no atendimento às famílias buscando a fidelização dos estudantes.

3.4 – Colabora na acolhida e orientação dos estudantes novatos.

– Gestão de conflitos.
